fixed: The **System default** date format now follows your device's language and region instead of the app language, so an English-language app on a phone set to Danish shows `15.7.2026`. It uses all-numbers dates, which keep the year. A region with no single date order (Belgium, say) uses your device language's default; pick a fixed format if you want another.
When the app is set to a language other than English, every User guide page now starts with a one-line notice that the guide is in English.
